name: oblique-dz-c
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, CAS1, COIN, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: CORNER-SPEED TWIN of 'oblique-dz' — identical geometry, identical replicate count; the ONLY difference is the entry condition, which is 0.95x each lane airframe's OWN corner speed instead of a flat 250 m/s. That is what lets all ten fixed-wing keys fly one card: at 250 m/s CAS1 and COIN are refused pre-spawn (above 0.95x Vmax) and the roster is 8. 0.95 rather than 1.00 because CAS1's published cornerSpeed (200) is itself above 0.95x its Vmax (195.3). startSpeed 250 is retained as the fail-soft fallback ONLY: if the envelope cannot be read the resolver warns and degrades to exactly the 'oblique-dz' condition, a known-good state, rather than to something novel. Rung 2: onset |azErr| = 2.50 deg, exactly FineBankDeadzone - the edge where the bank servo switches from zero to fully commanded (measured 43.5% -> 97.8% of samples across that boundary). A servo flickering in and out of its own deadzone is the classic chatter site, so this is the highest-suspicion rung for the 'confused small movement' report. Step magnitude 3.54 deg. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition. CARD-OWNED VALUES (v1.0.3): Drone/DroneAltDeckM = 0 - corpus: this card last flew in R29 (v0.93.0), before Drone/DroneAltDeckM existed (v0.99), so every lane flew one deck.
